Jason Wei 这条推文倒是没聊 AI，聊的是运动和职业思维的关系：你选的运动，可能在悄悄塑造你的职业大脑

推文提出了一个挺有意思的概念：“认知奖励形状”（cognitive reward shape），意思是不同运动对大脑的激励模式不一样，而这种模式会潜移默化地影响你在职业中的思维方式。

Jason

Most people have no idea which AI models their own laptop can actually run.

There's a free, open-source agent that answers that for you, then runs the model 100% on your machine.

It's called Magnitude. It runs AI models locally, fully offline, with no API keys and no token https://t.co/mnPAzhr2yZ

Here's the free guide to making AI agents actually useful:

https://t.co/FTrr6nlMQN

The rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

Follow if you'd rather run AI private and free on your own machine than pipe every prompt to a company's server.

In third grade, Grant LaFontaine sold a Pokemon card online. The buyer mailed a money order; Grant cashed it at the post office and then shipped the card to the customer.

Today he's co-founder and CEO of @Whatnot, where the largest businesses do over $100 million a year at up to https://t.co/4XRBXFveMt
AI creators are the kindest and most generous community
